# book Provider

The book service, reached at its endpoint with a machine client or a token



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `app_slug` (String) the app slug sent with every request, or APP_SLUG
- `client_id` (String) the machine client id, or CLIENT_ID
- `client_secret` (String, Sensitive) the machine client secret, or CLIENT_SECRET
- `endpoint` (String) the service base url, or ENDPOINT
- `token` (String, Sensitive) a bearer token, used before the client id and secret, or TOKEN
